name: Kasou = Genjitsu ~Harem Simulator~
original_name: 仮想＝現実～ハーレム・シミュレーター～
source:
Head Mounted Display has become a widely spread technology to visit virtual space. Main character attends online virtual courses at a private school. With time he starts to get interested in girls, but there are none around him. That is until the day he discovers a suspicious virtual space called "Harem Simulator".

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-july-2004-dear-my-friend.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
头戴式显示器已经成为广泛普及的技术，人们借此进入虚拟空间。主人公在一所私立学校参加在线虚拟课程。随着时间推移，他开始对女孩产生兴趣，身边却一个女孩也没有——直到某天，他发现了一个名为“后宫模拟器”的可疑虚拟空间。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-july-2004-dear-my-friend.html]vndbreview[/url]]
